judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The doddering-master voice and 'Hmmm... Quite so.' come close to Nox, but the tidy fetch-then-enrol arc, 'Will you help a half-blind old man?' and the explanatory 'You have shown the Imps were no match for you' read as a modern pastiche of the apprentice-test quest rather than Westwood's terser, odder lines.
